data.name: Holiday Inn Express & Suites Queretaro by IHG
data.address: Av. 5 de Febrero 110 Bis, Niños Heroes, 76010 Santiago de Querétaro, Qro., Mexico
data.description:
This modern hotel in a tower is 2 km from Zenea Garden, 3 km from the Museo Casa de la Zacatecana and 33 km from Querétaro Intercontinental Airport.
Sleek rooms feature free Wi-Fi, flat-screens, work desks and coffeemakers. Upgraded rooms add kitchens with dishwashers, plus living areas and pull-out sofas. Room service is available 24 hours.
Breakfast and parking are complimentary. A rooftop terrace features 2 hot tubs and seating. There's also an airport shuttle and a fitness room.
